gate_semantics.ALLOW: All core semantic prerequisites and active policy requirements are satisfied.
gate_semantics.DENY: At least one core semantic prerequisite or policy declaration is invalid.
gate_semantics.HUMAN_REQUIRED: Core semantic prerequisites pass, but an active policy requires a declared human approval that is not recorded.

PASS_WITH_FOLLOWUP.requires_for_progression: all open questions must be non-blocking

TASKS_TO_IMPLEMENT.description: A project, risk, or external governance profile may require human approval before implementation.

compatibility.policy: strict canonical writes; explicit tolerant legacy reads; no silent normalization

read_aliases.artifacts/: resolve relative to sdd_root and emit LEGACY_ARTIFACT_PATH

read_values.validation_result.PASS_WITH_FOLLOWUP: PASS with explicit warning and non-blocking-question gate
read_values.verification_result.PARTIAL: active invalid; archived tolerant read requiring migration review

blockers.SCHEMA_INVALID: The feature record does not conform to the v1 schema.
blockers.ALIAS_DIVERGENCE: Canonical and legacy alias fields disagree.
blockers.NON_CANONICAL_WRITE: A legacy alias or legacy value was used in canonical write mode.
blockers.ARCHIVE_TIMESTAMP_MISSING: An archived record has no archived_at timestamp.
blockers.INVALID_TRANSITION: The requested transition or regression is not declared.
blockers.REQUIRED_ARTIFACT_MISSING: A required primary artifact path is absent.
blockers.VALIDATION_NOT_PASSED: The effective validation result does not permit the transition.
blockers.VERIFICATION_NOT_EXECUTED: Verification did not produce canonical PASS or FAIL evidence.
blockers.BLOCKING_OPEN_QUESTION: At least one structured open question is blocking.
blockers.AUDIT_FAILED: AUDIT FAIL blocks ARCHIVE without a valid owner waiver.
blockers.OWNER_WAIVER_INVALID: The audit waiver is missing or invalid.
blockers.HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: The active policy requires an explicit human approval that is not recorded.
blockers.POLICY_REQUIREMENT_INVALID: The requested policy checkpoint is unknown or does not apply to this transition.
blockers.SOURCE_STATE_MISMATCH: The record state does not match the requested transition source state.

warning_codes.LEGACY_FEATURE_ID: feature_id was read as the legacy alias of id.
warning_codes.LEGACY_STATE_ALIAS: DONE or ARCHIVED was read as ARCHIVE.
warning_codes.LEGACY_TASKS_PATH: tasks_path was read as the legacy alias of task_path.
warning_codes.LEGACY_ARTIFACT_PATH: artifacts/... was read relative to sdd_root.
warning_codes.LEGACY_PASS_WITH_FOLLOWUP: validation_result PASS_WITH_FOLLOWUP was read as effective PASS.
warning_codes.LEGACY_PARTIAL_AMBIGUOUS: Archived verification_result PARTIAL is ambiguous and requires migration review.

audit_fail_repair.reason: A human decision or a future explicit rule is required.
